title: Cardioception Toolbox: measuring cardiac interoception in PsychoPy
description:
Cardioception is an open-source Python toolbox for studying how people perceive their own heartbeat. Built on PsychoPy, it brings the most widely used methods for measuring cardiac interoception together under one installation and one output layout: the Heart Rate Discrimination task, the Heartbeat Counting task, the Phase Adjustment Task and the Heartbeat Synchrony Discrimination task. The pulse is recorded from a USB pulse oximeter, or from ECG and PPG devices over Lab Streaming Layer.

This is the official release from the Embodied Computation Group at Aarhus University.
